description: This file contains the definition of the Smarty_Internal_ParseTree_Code class, which is part of the internal template parsing system of Smarty. The class represents a parse tree node for a code fragment within the Smarty template engine, providing methods for constructing a parse tree and converting it to PHP code.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_ParseTree_Code
classes.description: Represents a parse tree node for a code fragment inside a template, capable of generating PHP code representation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parse tree node with a code fragment string.

methods.name: to_smarty_php
methods.description: Returns the code fragment wrapped in parentheses as a PHP code string.
